usage: python -m games.fzerox.gate_inputs D:/n64work/fzerox/dirty D:/n64work/fzerox/clean D:/n64work/fzerox/gate; python -m cleanroom.originality D:/n64work/fzerox/gate D:/n64work/fzerox/gate games/fzerox/spec --manifest games/fzerox/originality.json --report ORIGINALITY.md  (both roots = the gate dir; retail halves are written there on the dirty side and never committed)

notes.music: 18 streamed music slots composed by music.py from slot length and rate only (seeded key, tempo, progression, riff, motif, section plan); compared as PCM (chroma DTW) because the retail soundtrack is recorded audio, not note data.
notes.text: Every game-text literal in the decomp source (names, menus, credits, messages), every text-bearing texture label and every announcer line is our own wording; names.json maps every retail proper noun and staff name.
notes.geometry: Courses: 26 slots regenerated by trackgen.py (our loops, heights, widths, shapes, banking, features; only venue/skybox/music slot and control-point count kept), compared as track-surface ribbons. Machines and course objects: machgeo.py (connectivity kept from the decomp's display-list code, positions new).
notes.images: All 1529 textures come from our kit (theme.py) or our drawing hooks; the spec keeps only size, format, segment, transparency flag and a coarse cover fraction.
notes.code: clean_code.bin = executable output sections of our build (boot, main, libleo, overlays); allowed = the linked bytes of each object compiled/assembled from decomp sources (linker map). Microcode = CRUCODE1 tags, IPL3 = our stub, libleo font-lookup blobs = our stubs.
